title: textured quads
shortDescription: Instanced quads with a texture, through TextureCoords and the TSL node colorFromTextureByTexCoords()
description: Builds on the `InstancedQuadsGeometry` of *instanced quads* and adds `texCoords` per instance. Texture and `TextureCoords` come from the texture catalog through a `TextureStore`; each quad takes its coordinates from `TextureCoords.getTexCoords()`, together with the flag for a diagonal flip. The node material reads them with `colorFromTextureByTexCoords()` and places the quads with `vertexByInstancePosition()`. Here every quad shows the whole image, which the preview in the corner shows as well.
